title: Null Controllability for Degenerate Parabolic Equations with Internal Control Applied on a Measurable Subset
summary: This work serves as a continuation of our preceding paper [28]. In that study, we presented a separable variable method to derive the Lebeau-Robbiano spectral inequality for a specific degenerate parabolic equation and subsequently employed it to demonstrate the null controllability of said equation when internal control is applied to an open subset. In the current paper, we reapply the separable variable method to attain the Lebeau-Robbiano spectral inequality for a different degenerate parabolic equation, and we substantiate the null controllability of this equation with internal control…
